_note: Sandbox stops 4 and 5 only (stopDef ambitions, the open grand campaign): a nation's dated reinforcement and formation rows from 'from' on come on its own war's clock, not the record's calendar (the historian's thresholds, historian/sandbox-thresholds.md, section 2). 'war' is the record's month that nation's great war began (W0); a row dated M comes at the month its own great war began plus (M - war), never before, and never while it has no such war. 'foes': the nations whose war starts the clock ('*' any great power but itself). Rows dated before 'from' come on their dates as at every stop (pre-war call-ups ran regardless of the war). Rows on the clock come unheld. 'rows': a row by name comes only in a month when it is at peace with every nation of 'peaceWith' and at war with one of 'warWith'; it waits until then. canBuildYet reads the same clock. Stops 1 to 3 read none of this.
